brief: A narrow stepped stone index shelf with three broad closed folio stacks, one diagonal empty bay and a split lower foot. Rightward rising silhouette. Worn cream paper, slate green stone, dark recesses. No legible writing.

An off-center sloping reading lectern on a curved load-bearing stone bracket; a single thick open blank folio supported by its lip. Clearly connected stem and broad heavy foot, shallow three-quarter view.
Low crescent-shaped stone cradle carrying three unequal rolled parchment cylinders. One unrolled edge falls across the front, exposing thickness; horizontal silhouette with quiet dark pockets.
An upright four-spoked iron floodgate wheel fixed to a short L-shaped masonry section with a broad copper axle collar. Strong circular opening against a low horizontal wall; nothing floating.
A three-step broken archive stair module: broad warm-gray slabs rise left to right, outer corner split away, small moss patch tucked into one seam. Thick visible slab edges; no debris field.
Two unequal stone-framed lattice panels joined by a visible aged bronze hinge, bent into an open V. One large open passage per panel, sparse crossing bars, asymmetrical silhouette.
A shallow oblong inkstone washing basin with a thick beveled lip and one broad dark reflective ink pool; short pouring notch at one end, stable offset plinth below. Quiet material planes.

A squat three-quarter stone survey table with a curled blank map held under one rectangular weight; a broad carved channel across one corner. Diagonal tabletop and continuous fitted supports, no symbols or relics.
